assist.is_pro: This person works with ADA Pro: they give me a code
assist.pro_no_coffre: A professional can never open Mon Coffre in this mode.
assist.areas: What they can do with you
assist.never_password: change your password, your e-mail address or your phone number;
assist.never_delete: delete your account or download all your data;
assist.never_coffre: open Mon Coffre, unless you tick it (never for a professional).
assist.logged: Everything they view or do is written in your history, with their name.
assist.consent: I agree that this person helps me on my account, for what I chose and for the time I chose.
assist.password_start: Your password (to confirm it is really you)
assist.password_private: Type it yourself. Do not give it to the person helping you.
assist.history_empty: Nobody has helped you with this mode yet.
assist.banner_text: {{name}} is helping you until {{time}}. Everything is written in your history.
delegations.log_executed: did it for you (without asking you): {{what}}
delegations.act_on_done: This person can now act for you in this part, without asking you. You can withdraw this agreement at any time.
delegations.act_off_done: Agreement withdrawn: each action will be asked of you again.
delegations.actions_intro: They can also ASK you to carry out an action (cancel an appointment, update a step). Nothing is done without your agreement, unless you allow them to act for you in one part.
delegations.request_until: Without an answer, the request is cancelled on {{date}}.
delegations.act_allow: Allow them to act without asking me
delegation_view.ask_done: Done: the person allowed you to act without asking them. They see it in their history.
delegation_view.ask_sent: Request sent: nothing is done until the person accepts it (48 hours at most).
delegation_view.ask_intro: You can ask for an action (cancel an appointment, change the state of a step). The person must accept it, unless they allowed you to act without asking them.
delegation_view.req_status: Change of state of a step
notifications.kind.delegation_action_req: A trusted person asks you to confirm an action. Nothing is done without your agreement.
space.tile.accompagnement_body: Get help, next to you, for 2 hours at most.
space.tile.situation_body: Aid to check, procedures and places, depending on what is happening to you.
space.tile.passeport_body: Your documents and your summary, encrypted on this device only.
space.tile.orientations_sociales_body: Proposals from an organisation to refer you to another: nothing is sent without your agreement.
terms_change.title: Our terms of use have changed
terms_change.body: A new version has been in force since {{date}}. It describes new functions, when they are open: Mon foyer, trusted persons, legal protection, Mon Coffre and the messages of an appointment. Our privacy notice has changed too.
parcours.limited.already: This step is already in Mon Parcours.
parcours.limited.place_gone: The chosen place is no longer published.
parcours.limited.notice_body: You choose a procedure from a list of common procedures and, if you wish, a public place where to do it. Mon Parcours records no free text and offers no procedure related to health, disability, justice, the right of residence or another sensitive situation: for those, talk to a person who supports you.
parcours.limited.notice_rights: Only you can see your steps: no organisation, professional or trusted person has access. You can delete a step at any time and download your data from My profile.
parcours.limited.place_query: Name of the place or of the town
parcours.limited.place_empty: No place found for this procedure.
notifications.kind.parcours_closed_expir: A finished step of Mon Parcours will be deleted in 30 days. You can download your data before.
